script_text: Stop! Aquarius, the stars are screaming at you right now. Uranus, your ruling planet, is sextiling Jupiter in your 5th House of Creativity while the Sun opposes Pluto in your 7th House of Partnerships, exposing power struggles. As an Air sign, this electric tension makes single Aquarians magnetic to unconventional lovers who value your freedom. Taken ones must avoid silent resentment festering near midday. In career, Mercury trines Saturn in your 10th House of Status, sealing a contract or promotion through disciplined communication—protect that income. Warning: do not sign anything impulsively under the Pluto opposition or you'll regret the fine print. Subscribe so you don't miss what's coming this week.
